messages:
Hana Li: quick follow-up from today's regional failover drill. We identified 3 repeat items: overlapping route policy updates, missing cross-region snapshot copies, and unclear post-restore checks. Need owners + ETAs.
Carlos Mendez: I can take routing. Plan: add a HOLD step during policy rollouts and a weight-ramp. Will run a eu-west canary. ETA: 48h.
Priya Rao: I'll handle snapshots. Found 6 snaps without replication tags. Will add snapshots/ to replication filter and ship a verifier script `snap-check.sh`. ETA: scan tonight, repair tomorrow.
Jon Park: I'll update the restore runbook. Will add exact SQL for replica lag, expected ms thresholds, and a post-restore smoke test sequence. Draft by Fri EOD.
DR-Helper: Jira EPIC RINF-2701 created: "DR: follow-ups - routing, snapshots, runbook" by Hana Li.
Hana Li: owners recap: Carlos = routing + canary (48h), Priya = snapshot verifier & repair (24-48h), Jon = runbook updates (5d). I'll track in the epic and run weekly check-ins.
Carlos Mendez: prototype nginx snippet posted in repo PR; need canary access to `canary-eu`. @Hana Li can you grant?
Hana Li: granted access to `canary-eu`.
Priya Rao: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/412 (verifier draft). Outputs CSV and supports `--fix` dry-run.
Jon Park: runbook PR: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr-restore/pull/116 (includes CHECK_REPLICA SQL and validation steps).
Hana Li: timeline summary: snapshot scan today, repairs by +1 day, routing canary results by +2 days, runbook final by +5 days. If blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
